answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 15947 Country: MA Title: assalamualaykum, can you please answer that: i inshaallah have the intention of keeping a sunnah beard and will not trim. However, at what limit can i trim(asfter one fist). I have heard i can trim above my jaw-line. Can i also trim the side below my ears to give it a good decent look. please answer, jazakallah Question: assalamualaykum, can you please answer that: i inshaallah have the intention of keeping a sunnah beard and will not trim. However, at what limit can i trim (asfter one fist). I have heard i can trim above my jaw-line. Can i also trim the side below my ears to give it a good decent look. please answer, jazakallah Answer ID: 15947 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1610/143/TB=1430) You have intended to keep sunnah beard, may Allah give you determination and barakah . You should grow beard at least to one fist size, then you can trim the extra length. It is also allowable to set the beard by trimming the hair on jaw-line towards the ear. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
